title: How an internal-gear hub drivetrain works
summary: Follow power from the single chainring to the rear sprocket and understand why the selectable ratios live inside the rear hub.

steps.title: The outside drivetrain stays simple.
steps.body: Pedal force travels from the crankset to one front chainring, through the chain, and onto one external rear sprocket.
steps.keyFact: Unlike a derailleur drivetrain, Urban U1 does not shift the chain across a cassette.

steps.title: The gear changes happen inside the hub.
steps.body: The rear hub contains the gear mechanism that selects different transmission ratios while the chain continues to run on the same rear sprocket.
steps.keyFact: One visible rear sprocket does not mean the bicycle has only one gear.

steps.title: A chain guard protects the exposed drive path.
steps.body: The full chain guard covers much of the chain and chainring area. It helps separate clothing from the drivetrain and shields the external chain from everyday splash and dirt.
steps.keyFact: A chain guard reduces exposure; it does not make the drivetrain maintenance-free.

steps.title: External checks and internal service are different jobs.
steps.body: Chain condition, chain tension/alignment symptoms, sprocket wear and shift behavior can be observed externally. Opening or servicing an internal-gear hub depends on the exact hub design and its service documentation.
steps.keyFact: Bike Atlas should not generalize internal-hub oil, grease, adjustment or service intervals across different hub systems.

challenge.prompt: Where are Urban U1's selectable gear ratios created?

options.label: By moving the chain between front chainrings

challenge.explanation: The internal-gear hub changes ratios inside the rear hub while the chain remains on one external rear sprocket.

steps.title: Find the single external rear gear.
steps.body: Identify the rear sprocket that receives chain force before the hub's internal mechanism changes the effective ratio.
steps.keyFact: The rear sprocket is outside the hub; the selectable gear mechanism is inside.

challenge.prompt: Which external part directly engages the chain at the rear wheel?
challenge.successText: Correct. The chain drives the single external rear sprocket.
challenge.retryText: That part belongs to the rear wheel system, but it is not the sprocket engaged by the chain.
